_note: Common names offered as suggestions while typing; people can still type others. Names here should match how jobs are written, so matching works. renew_years is the usual renewal cycle, used to suggest an expiry date from the date someone got it; note is shown when they add it. Cycles are Queensland-focused (see the research report): check them before relying on them elsewhere.
